Conjecture:             never divides           if p, q are distinct primes. The
                        p−1                    q−1
validity of this conjecture would simplify the proof of solvability of groups of odd order
(W. Feit, J. G. Thompson, Pacific J. Math., 13, no. 3 (1963), 775–1029), rendering
unnecessary the detailed use of generators and relations.                 J. G. Thompson
